item.title: Shock Call to Execute Elon Musk, Hegseth Impeachment Push, and Truth About Absurd Puff Piece, with Matt Taibbi | Ep. 1438 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Matt Taibbi, founder of Racket News, to discuss the growing calls to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, what's really behind the push from Rep. Thomas Massie and the Democrats, Hegseth's response and whether he might be out of the role soon, growing tensions between the GOP establishment and Vice President JD Vance, Marco Rubio and Hegseth’s recent explanations about the decision to go to war with Iran, Scott Galloway’s shocking comments about wanting Elon Musk executed for treason, Galloway claiming he defecated in his own Tesla before he sold it, the way Trump Derangement Syndrome damages people, why some of Charlie Kirk's most ardent critics don't understand his approach to debate and discussion, Jennifer Welch’s disgusting comments about him, President Trump’s changing rhetoric on immigration, new questions about the Florida private plane crash, whether the aircraft was missing key radar equipment that could have helped detect the storm, a glowing profile of reporter Dianna Russini who allegedly had an affair with her football coach source, the truth about what happened and how it's being spun now, Prince Harry’s comments about protecting children online, the timing of his remarks amid the arrest of Meghan Markle’s father, and more.

 

 

More from Taibbi: https://www.racket.news/
